description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates the runtime in seconds for different models, including "Our Joint Framework" and four "LLM Models" (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude). The vertical axis represents "Runtime (seconds)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked with dashed gridlines at intervals of 50. The horizontal axis lists the five model categories. A legend in the top-left corner indicates that the dark green bars represent "Our Joint Framework" and the blue-gray bars represent "LLM Models." The chart contains five bars: the "Our Joint Framework" bar is dark green and has a value of 77 seconds. The "LLM Models" bars are blue-gray, with ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds, LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. Each bar's value is labeled directly above it. The bars are arranged in the order of the categories listed on the horizontal axis, which is not sorted by runtime. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and value labeling.
